& who know
eth but what they will be the means of bringing many thousands of them yea
& also many thousands of our stiffnecked brethren the Nephites which are

Red
eemer now these mysteries are not yet fully made known unto me therefore I
shall forbare
& it may suffise if I only say they are preserved for a wise purpose
which purpose is known unto God for he doth counsel in wisdom over all

O remember
remember my son Helaman how strict are the commandments of God & he say

ised unto them that he would reserve these things for a wise purpose in

therefore I com
mand you my son Helaman the ye be diligent in fulfiling all my words &

& the Lord said I will
prepare unto my servant Gazelem a stone which shall shine forth in darkness

& now my Son we see that they did not repent
lines.markdown: & now my ~~Son~~ [Son] we see that they did not repent

for behold there is a curse upon

therefore ye shall keep these secret plans of

for behold they murdered all the prophets of the Lord

& now my Son remember
the words which I have spoken unto you trust not those secret plans unto this peo

preach unto
them repentance & faith on the Lord Jesus Christ teach them to humble themsel

teach them to never be weary
of good works but to be meek & lowly in heart for shuch shall find rest to their

O remember my Son & learn wisdom in thy youth yea learn in thy youth to
keep the commandments of God
yea & cry unto God for all thy support yea let all
thy doings be unto the Lord & whithersoever thou goest let it be in the Lord

the thing which our fathers call a ball or director or our father called it

there cannot any man work after the manner of so curious a workmanship &

nevertheless because those miracels were worked by small me
ans nevertheless it did shew unto them marvelous works they were slothful &

therefore they tarried in
the wilderness or did not travail a direct course & were afflicted with hun

& now my Son I would that ye shou
ld understand that these things are not without a shadow for as our fathers

for beh
old it is as easy to give heed to the word of Christ which will point to you a

now I say is there not a type in this thing for just as suredly as this director did
bring our fathers by following its course to the promised land shall the word of Christ
if we follow ◊t◊ course carry us beyond this vale of tears into a far better land

O my Son do not let us be slothful because of the easiness of the way
for so was it with our fathers for so was it prepared for them that if they
would look they might live even so it is with us the way is prepared &
if we will look we may live forever
& now my Son see that ye take care
